newsitem.title: UK: ML Hldgs names Derek Crook chief executive.
newsitem.headline: ML Hldgs names Derek Crook chief executive.

text.p: Electronics and electrical group ML Holdings Plc said on Tuesday that Derek Crook will become chief executive following the retirement of Howard Grant "towards the end of the year."

In a statement the company said Crook, who has been director of the group's electronic component distribution operations, has also been appointed chief operating officer for the group with immediate effect.
ML added that Michael Jones, who has been in charge of ML Holdings' engineering interests, has resigned from the company, reflecting "the change in emphasis in the group's interests."
